subject: latent mediator model with ordered outcomes

messages.author: 531277efd36d5693
messages.subject: latent mediator model with ordered outcomes
parts:
Dear Lavaan Group

I am trying to fit a latent mediator model with ordered outcomes. Here is the structure of my model:

model1 = '

## measurement model
f1 =~ Item_1 + Item_2 + Item_3 + Item_5
f2 =~ Item_7 + Item_8 + Item_10

## mediation with socio-demographics
f1 ~ Age + Family_Size + Gender + no_of_workers
f2 ~ Age + Family_Size + Gender + no_of_workers

## Final sem model
Res_Status ~ Age + Family_Size + Gender + no_of_workers + dist_work + f1  ##Res_Status binary with owned or rented
Car_Own ~ Age + Family_Size + Gender + no_of_workers + dist_work + f2  ## Car_Own binary with yes or no
'

sem(model1, data = mydata, estimator = "WLSMV", meanstructure = TRUE, 
        ordered = c("Res_Status", "Car_Own")) -> model1.fit

I get the following error message:
Error in lavaan::lavaan(model = model1, data = mydata, ordered = c("Res_Status",  : 
  lavaan ERROR: some latent variable names collapse with observed
variable names: f1, f2

Any help or clarification regarding the error or model specification is highly appreciated.
Thanks in advance
Punyabeet
